svg.aria-label: The weave: 16 projects across 11 skill threads
svg.title: The weave: 16 projects across 11 skill threads
svg.text: Each row is a shipped project, each thread a skill family found in its real stack.
Where the thread rises in colour, the skill was used. Nothing hand-picked.
